title: Threat corridor demo
consent_html: This is a demo of the threat-corridor paradigm of jspsych-fps-lab. You stand in a corridor; monsters appear one at a time in alcoves ahead of, beside or behind you. Shoot each one as quickly as you can. In this demo the monsters don't fight back.
instructions_html:
How to play

W A S D move, the mouse turns and left click fires. Esc pauses the game.

Each round, monsters appear one at a time in the alcoves of the corridor, with a flash and a sound. Turn to them and shoot. A round ends when the last monster is down or when its time is up.

questions.name: startle
questions.prompt: How startling were the monsters' appearances?
